    await sendReauthNotification(connection.account_id, connection.platform);

mutations.name: CC3-2 A connection with no refresh token sends no notification

await sendReauthNotification(connection.account_id, connection.platform);
    return { valid: false, error: 'NO_REFRESH_TOKEN', requiresReauth: true };
mutations.replace: return { valid: false, error: 'NO_REFRESH_TOKEN', requiresReauth: true };
